about: Definition cards for the reanalysis engine: what each firm code is for, its usual suppliers and words, and the common wrong postings with their right code. The cards are the only place such a rule lives; the engine never ties a supplier to a code outside a card or the client's own history. Drafted 28 Oct 2026 from the SOP's examples and the 3,163 moves in 100 of his final WPs' reanalysis tabs (count = moved lines involving the code); every card is a draft until an accountant reviews it. Firm data: another firm keeps its own copy.

cards.name: Computer software costs
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Software licences and subscriptions used to run the business.

excludes.item: computer hardware over the capitalisation limit
computer hardware under the limit, IT consumables
website build or hosting
personal streaming or music (Netflix, Spotify, Disney+)
online advertising (Facebook, Google Ads, LinkedIn ads)
training courses and coaching apps

sector_variants: Design studios: Adobe is a direct cost (1100 range) when the client recharges it
cards.vat_note: Overseas suppliers: reverse charge, no UK VAT on the invoice

cards.name: Subscriptions
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Memberships and recurring services that are not software: trade bodies, professional bodies and journals.

excludes.item: software subscriptions
personal subscriptions (Amazon Prime, Netflix, Disney+, Twitch)

cards.vat_note: Professional body fees are often exempt

cards.name: Computer and IT consumables
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Small IT items and accessories below the capitalisation limit.

excludes.item: computers over the capitalisation limit
phone and broadband bills

cards.name: Telecommunications and data costs
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Phone, mobile and broadband used for the business.

excludes.item: a personal mobile with no business use

cards.name: Travel and subsistence expenses
cards.heading: Employee costs
cards.definition: Business journeys and meals away from the usual place of work.

excludes.item: food shopping with no business trip
staff food and drink at work
fuel for business vehicles
travel that is a direct cost of a job the client recharges

sector_variants: Food businesses: supermarket purchases are cost of sales (1100), not travel
cards.vat_note: Overseas hotels and fares carry no UK VAT
cards.tax_note: Allowable when on a business trip

cards.name: Vehicle fuel costs
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Fuel for business vehicles.

excludes.item: fuel for a private car with no mileage claim

cards.vat_note: Private use of business fuel may need the fuel scale charge

cards.name: Vehicle parking costs
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Parking for business vehicles.

excludes.item: parking fines and penalty charge notices

cards.vat_note: On-street parking is outside the scope of VAT

cards.name: Accountancy fees
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: The company's own accounts, tax and compliance work.

excludes.item: fees for the directors' personal tax returns

evidence.source: SOP example (TaxAssist personal returns moved to the DLA on 22 jobs)

cards.name: Advertising and marketing costs
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Promoting the business: ads, marketing materials, sponsorship.

excludes.item: software used to run the business
client hospitality

cards.vat_note: Meta and Google ads: reverse charge

cards.name: Entertaining
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Hospitality for clients and suppliers (disallowable for corporation tax).
includes: client gifts of food and drink

excludes.item: staff events
business trip meals

cards.vat_note: No input VAT on business entertaining

cards.name: Staff welfare
cards.heading: Employee costs
cards.definition: Refreshments and welfare items for staff at work.

excludes.item: staff parties and events
food for resale

sector_variants: Food businesses: supermarket purchases are usually cost of sales (1100)

cards.name: Staff training
cards.heading: Employee costs
cards.definition: Courses and training for staff and directors related to the business.

excludes.item: software used to run the business

cards.tax_note: Allowable when it updates existing skills

cards.name: Repairs and maintenance
cards.heading: Premises expenses
cards.definition: Keeping premises and equipment in working order.
includes: small tools and parts for repairs

excludes.item: improvements or new equipment over the capitalisation limit
materials used in client jobs

sector_variants: Builders: materials for client jobs are cost of sales (1100)

cards.name: Insurance
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Business insurance: liability, contents, professional indemnity.

excludes.item: vehicle insurance
personal life or health cover

cards.vat_note: Exempt from VAT (insurance premium tax instead)
cards.balance_sheet_link: 4900 prepayments when the policy runs past the year end

cards.name: Printing, postage and stationery
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Printing, postage and office stationery.

excludes.item: client hospitality
personal subscriptions

cards.name: Other office costs
cards.heading: General admin
cards.definition: Office running costs that have no more specific code.
includes: office supplies with no better head

excludes.item: goods for resale or used in the product
software

cards.name: Purchases
cards.heading: Cost of sales
cards.definition: Goods bought for resale or used in making the product or doing client jobs.
includes: food supplies for a café or caterer

excludes.item: office supplies
repairs to the business's own premises

sector_variants: Depends on the industry: the same supplier is an overhead for a business that does not resell

cards.name: Other direct costs
cards.heading: Cost of sales
cards.definition: Costs of doing client work that are not purchases or labour.

excludes.item: general business travel

cards.name: Subcontractor costs (cost of sales)
cards.heading: Cost of sales
cards.definition: Labour bought in from self-employed workers for client work.

excludes.item: directors
employees on the payroll

cards.vat_note: Construction: domestic reverse charge between CIS-registered businesses

evidence.source: SOP; bank test: 253 payments to named people the accountant coded here

cards.name: Directors loan account
cards.heading: Current liabilities
cards.definition: Money between the company and the director personally.
includes: personal spending from the business account

excludes.item: business costs paid personally by the director: the cost code, credit 5400

cards.vat_note: No input VAT on personal items
cards.tax_note: Overdrawn at the year end: s455; benefits may need a P11D

cards.name: VAT
cards.heading: Current liabilities
cards.definition: VAT on valid VAT invoices only.
includes: VAT on supplier invoices with a valid VAT number

excludes.item: VAT claimed with no valid VAT (overseas apps, marketplace sellers, exempt items): back to the cost code

sector_variants: Flat Rate Scheme: no input VAT except capital items

cards.name: Sales
cards.heading: Sales
cards.definition: Income from the business's goods and services.

excludes.item: refunds from suppliers: the cost code
platform fees on gross-up (Airbnb, Booking.com, Uber, Deliveroo, Just Eat, Etsy)
